mapper.select: SELECT WORKBOOK_SEQ, WORKBOOK_NAME, OWNER_USER, DOC_VER, DOC_TYPE, USE_YN, SHARE_TOKEN FROM wo_workbook_master WHERE WORKBOOK_SEQ = #{workbookSeq} AND DEL_DATETIME IS NULL

SELECT W.WORKBOOK_SEQ, W.WORKBOOK_NAME, W.OWNER_USER, W.DOC_TYPE, 'OWNER' AS ROLE_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wo_workbook_member_map M WHERE M.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) AS MEMBER_COUNT, CASE WHEN W.SHARE_TOKEN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS SHARED_PUBLICLY, COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) AS MODIFIED_AT FROM wo_workbook_master W WHERE W.OWNER_USER = #{userKey} AND W.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL
AND NOT ( W.WORKBOOK_NAME = #{untitled} AND W.SHARE_TOKEN IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_workbook_member_map M2 WHERE M2.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND M2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_workbook_sheet_line S2 JOIN wo_sheet_cell_line C2 ON C2.SHEET_SEQ = S2.SHEET_SEQ WHERE S2.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND S2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND C2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_workbook_sheet_line S3 JOIN wo_sheet_drawing_line D3 ON D3.SHEET_SEQ = S3.SHEET_SEQ WHERE S3.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND S3.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND D3.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_doc_paragraph_line P2 WHERE P2.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND LENGTH(P2.TEXT_VALUE) > 0) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wo_workbook_sheet_line S4 WHERE S4.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND S4.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) <= 1 ) ORDER BY COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) DESC, W.WORKBOOK_SEQ DESC

SELECT W.WORKBOOK_SEQ, W.WORKBOOK_NAME, W.OWNER_USER, W.DOC_TYPE, M.ROLE_CODE, 0 AS MEMBER_COUNT, CASE WHEN W.SHARE_TOKEN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS SHARED_PUBLICLY, COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) AS MODIFIED_AT FROM wo_workbook_master W JOIN wo_workbook_member_map M ON M.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ WHERE M.MEMBER_USER = #{userKey} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND W.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND W.OWNER_USER <> #{userKey} ORDER BY COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) DESC, W.WORKBOOK_SEQ DESC

SELECT W.WORKBOOK_SEQ, W.WORKBOOK_NAME, W.OWNER_USER, W.DOC_TYPE, CASE WHEN W.OWNER_USER = #{userKey} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE M.ROLE_CODE END AS ROLE_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wo_workbook_member_map MC WHERE MC.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND MC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MC.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL) AS MEMBER_COUNT, CASE WHEN W.SHARE_TOKEN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS SHARED_PUBLICLY, COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) AS MODIFIED_AT, (SELECT MIN(C.TEXT_VALUE) FROM wo_workbook_sheet_line S JOIN wo_sheet_cell_line C ON C.SHEET_SEQ = S.SHEET_SEQ WHERE S.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND S.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND C.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND UPPER(C.TEXT_VALUE) LIKE #{like}) AS CELL_TEXT, (SELECT MIN(P.TEXT_VALUE) FROM wo_doc_paragraph_line P WHERE P.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND P.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND UPPER(P.TEXT_VALUE) LIKE #{like}) AS PARA_TEXT FROM wo_workbook_master W LEFT JOIN wo_workbook_member_map M ON M.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND M.MEMBER_USER = #{userKey} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL WHERE W.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (W.OWNER_USER = #{userKey} OR M.WORKBOOK_SEQ IS NOT NULL) AND ( UPPER(W.WORKBOOK_NAME) LIKE #{like} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_workbook_sheet_line S2 JOIN wo_sheet_cell_line C2 ON C2.SHEET_SEQ = S2.SHEET_SEQ WHERE S2.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND S2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND C2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND UPPER(C2.TEXT_VALUE) LIKE #{like}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_doc_paragraph_line P2 WHERE P2.WORKBOOK_SEQ = W.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND P2.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL AND UPPER(P2.TEXT_VALUE) LIKE #{like}) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(W.MOD_DATETIME, W.INPUT_DATETIME) DESC, W.WORKBOOK_SEQ DESC
SELECT WORKBOOK_SEQ, WORKBOOK_NAME, OWNER_USER, DOC_VER, USE_YN, SHARE_TOKEN FROM wo_workbook_master WHERE SHARE_TOKEN = #{shareToken} AND DEL_DATETIME IS NULL
